title: Clear the disconnected computer’s view
responsibility: Clears the workspace’s remote project view and replaces a project address with the start address.

inputs.name: accountView.workspace
inputs.description: A Workspace instance inspected to decide whether the displayed project belongs to its own Hub account. The view qualifies only when hostedStatus is truthy, capabilities.source is github, and snapshot.project.id is absent or does not start with local-.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.workspace
inputs.description: A mutable Workspace instance whose pending work is invalidated and whose computer-owned projects are removed. When it has a hosted account, non-local projects and an eligible own-account view are retained; otherwise its project list and remote view are cleared.

inputs.name: forgetRemote.notice
inputs.description: The string assigned to workspace.error after invalidation and view handling. Defaults to the empty string.

outputs.name: forgetRemote
outputs.description: Whether workspace.bridge.hostedStatus is truthy after invalidation and view handling. The caller uses true to list the hosted account again; the boolean does not indicate whether an eligible account view was preserved.

outputs.name: accountView
outputs.description: Whether the workspace has a hosted account, uses the github capability source, and its snapshot project id is not local- prefixed. A missing snapshot project id passes the project-id check.
